deficiencies.description: The rewrite interprets the lecturer's deictic pointing words ('here', 'This') as a spatial relation ('lies next to the outer surface of the uterus') that is not stated in the text.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: You can see that the tumor is here. This is the outer surface of the uterus.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: The tumour lies next to the outer surface of the uterus

considerations.sourcePassage: So you can see again that this is actually circumspect and very separate from the surrounding stroma and the surrounding tissue.
considerations.reason: The replacement of 'circumspect' with 'circumscribed' corrects an obvious slip of the tongue or transcription error to the scientifically correct pathological term describing a well-demarcated benign tumour.

considerations.sourcePassage: So you can see again that this is actually circumspect and very separate from the surrounding stroma and the surrounding tissue.
considerations.reason: 'therefore' translates the lecturer's inferential 'So you can see', reflecting the observation made from the histological appearance rather than introducing an unsupported causal link.
